limitations: Monte Carlo calibration estimates the tested E83/E88 policy-selection model; it does not replace the distribution-free E91 guarantee.
The 192 cases cover four representative estimator accuracies and three E91 sample-requirement quantiles, not every prevalence profile.
The first empirically certified sample is selected from a coarse seven-point fraction grid and is not an exact minimum.
Clopper-Pearson bounds cover Monte Carlo uncertainty only, not model misspecification or traffic nonstationarity.
The audit reuses compact E83 path summaries and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Deterministically simulate finite multinomial prevalence samples and the full lexicographic policy selector at representative easy, median, and hard E91 profiles. Compare observed over-tolerance selection with the conservative distribution-free L1 certificate.

simulation.random_seed: SHA256-derived per case and sample size
